group.title: Group
group.description: The rate-limit group this entry's limits apply to.

id.title: Id
id.description: Identifier of this rate-limit entry. It is stable within the organization and differs between organizations; the group's own identifier is `group.id`. Pass it as `rate_limit_id` to set a workspace's overrides for this group.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: The limiter values that apply to this group.

models.title: Models
models.description: Model names this entry's limits apply to, including aliases. `null` when `group.type` is not `"model_group"`. The list covers the models your organization has access to, so it can differ between organizations.

type.title: Type
type.description: Object type. Always `rate_limit` for organization rate-limit entries.
